# ShiftHub — Seed Demo Data (run once)

Populates the Rota tab with a realistic SIWES demo set, INCLUDING a shift starting in ~3h05m with no confirmations — the exact case the 3-hour supervisor alert exists for.

Run manually after connecting the Google Sheets credential. Clear the Rota tab first if you re-seed. Do not use in production.

nodes.name: Build Seed Rows
nodes.notes: Relative-date demo rows; token is random per row.

nodes.name: Append Seed Rows
nodes.notes: Appends the demo assignments to the Rota tab.
